title: Headset slips
intro: You'll move the headset on your face on purpose, five ways: up, down, to your left, to your right, and tilted. Each time it's one hand on the front and a few millimetres, no more; each step says how. The picture may blur a little while it's moved: that's fine. Then you take it off and put it back on.

steps.text: Look at the dot. When it says Push up and beeps:|Hold the front with one hand, thumb under the bottom edge, and push the headset straight up a few millimetres, so it sits higher on your face. Keep it level: both sides go up together.|Only the headset moves: your head stays still and your eyes stay on the dot. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.

Look at the dot. When it says Pull down and beeps:|Hold the front with one hand, thumb under the bottom edge, and pull the headset straight down a few millimetres, the way a loose headset sags. Keep it level: both sides go down together.|Only the headset moves: your head stays still and your eyes stay on the dot. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.

Look at the dot. When it says Slide to your left and beeps:|Hold the front with one hand, thumb under the bottom edge, and slide the headset a few millimetres to your left, across your face. Keep it level and at the same height.|Only the headset moves: your head stays still and your eyes stay on the dot. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.

Look at the dot. When it says Slide to your right and beeps:|Hold the front with one hand, thumb under the bottom edge, and slide the headset a few millimetres to your right, across your face. Keep it level and at the same height.|Only the headset moves: your head stays still and your eyes stay on the dot. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.

Look at the dot. When it says Tilt: left side up and beeps:|Hold the front with one hand, thumb under the bottom edge, and turn your wrist so the headset's left side goes up a few millimetres and its right side down, so it sits crooked on your face. Its middle stays where it is.|Only the headset moves: your head stays still and your eyes stay on the dot. Hold it there until it says Let go and beeps low.
Keep holding the headset there. Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
Keep holding it until it says Let go. Then put the headset back as it was, and look at the dot.
Take the headset off, put it back on as you usually do, then press the button.
Look at each dot until its ring fills. Keep your head still.
